reason: I have never seen a washing machine with a battery inside, and nobody in my family or village has one yet. With money set aside for the wedding, I will not spend twenty-two thousand on something new until someone I know has used it through a season.
objection: Will a cold wash really get the mud out of farm clothes? And will the battery still hold a charge after two summers, or does it just become dead weight?
would_change_my_mind: A relative or neighbour using one for a few months and telling me it cleans muddy clothes and keeps going through the power cuts, with the dealer I already trust standing behind it.
